recognize_zh: 上方細胞有灰藍色細胞質，核已分成兩團染色體（分裂後期/末期的有絲分裂像）；下方細胞有深藍色細胞質、核圓且染色質呈粗點狀，是嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞；背景可見多染性大紅血球與淚滴形紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性造血中活躍的紅系增生。
features: Mitotic erythroid precursor in anaphase/telophase with two separated chromosome clusters in grey-blue cytoplasm
Basophilic erythroblast with deeply blue cytoplasm and a round nucleus with coarsely stippled chromatin
Both precursors enlarged relative to normoblastic counterparts
Large polychromatophilic red cell and teardrop cells in the background
Anisopoikilocytosis with fragmented and irregular red cells; smear stroma at upper right
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two erythroid precursors. The upper cell is an enlarged erythroid precursor in late mitosis (anaphase/telophase), and the lower cell is a basophilic erythroblast with intensely basophilic cytoplasm and a round nucleus with stippled chromatin. The background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with large polychromatophilic cells and teardrop forms. The findings reflect erythroid proliferation with megaloblastic features, consistent with B12/folate deficiency.

ddx.dx: Erythroid hyperplasia of hemolysis or blood loss
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia shows increased mitoses but normoblastic, size-appropriate precursors with synchronous chromatin condensation.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature erythroid cells with atypical mitoses and multinucleation rather than a complete, maturing megaloblastic series.
Atypical mitoses show three or more chromosome clusters or lagging chromosomes, whereas this division is bipolar.
